ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity pixels (black/dark grey) comprise approximately 94% of the visible surface; high-intensity pixels (white/cream) are isolated to localized clusters at the distal lobe extremities.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Near-uniform dark pigmentation across the contiguous fluke surface area. High-contrast white/tan geometric blobs are spatially mapped to the distal tips of both lobes. Sparse, circular high-intensity point-source pixels are scattered across the interior of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 52 degrees at the central axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitudes varying between 5 and 20 pixels along the entire visible trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve along the trailing margins terminating in tapered, slightly recurved distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, roughly circular clusters of high-contrast pixels (barnacle structures) localized on the outer margins of both lobes. Scattered smaller, circular white 'rosette' scars visible on the central surface of the left lobe lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive clusters of calcified, textured structures (barnacles) localized at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant pixel-level spray and droplets originating from the serrated trailing edges, partially obscuring the lower central fluke and water-interface boundary.
